content:
PARTNER charges 15 basis points with a 200-cent minimum when eligible linked external receipts net of refunds over ninety days remain at least 15,000,000 cents. Only settled external receipts and settled refunds count.

Eligibility is checked at execution. A pending refund can change it when settled; a current quote does not freeze the threshold. If the condition is no longer met, BASIC applies to that execution.
